# Prism

> Prism builds your application into a holo, a content-addressed package that carries its own proof and provenance, and checks them before anything runs.

## Reference

- [Holo format](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/holo-format): The byte layout of a .holo file, its sections, digests and format revisions.
- [Attestations reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/attestations): The statement and envelope a holo's attestations use, the predicate types and their status.
- [Manifest reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/manifest): Every table and key in prism.toml.
- [Lockfile reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/lockfile): Every field of the lockfile, from the schema the spec package publishes.
- [Errors reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/errors): Every error code the runtime raises and every CLI exit code.
- [CLI reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/cli): Every prism verb, its flags, its exit codes and its usage.

## API Reference

- [prism-code at a glance](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api): Load a holo, dispatch an input and replay its examples from Node.js with the prism-code runtime.
- [Load a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/load): Read a holo from a path, a URL or bytes and get an application you can inspect and run.
- [Inspect a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/inspect): Read the manifest, digests, world and attestations of a holo without running it.
- [Check a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/verify): Check digest, provenance, proof and world against a policy and get a verdict.
- [Instantiate a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/instantiate): Create a running instance with exactly the capability set you grant.
- [Dispatch inputs](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/dispatch): Send one request to the holo and get its response.
- [History and replay](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/history-and-replay): Replay the examples a holo carries and prove its behaviour unchanged.
- [Use a holo as a tool](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/as-tool): Wrap a checked holo as a Vercel AI SDK tool so a model can call it.
- [Error types](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/errors): Every error the runtime throws and the code it carries.
- [Spec package](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/spec-package): The types, JSON Schemas, world file and format revision that every runtime is built from.
- [Check in the browser](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/verify-package): Check a holo offline in any browser without loading the runtime.
- [Testing package](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/testing-package): Test code that drives a holo with a mock host, skipped time and scripted dispatch.
